title: Miele — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Miele.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Immer Besser (Forever Better)." Luxury tier. Miele has been family-owned since 1899 — four generations, never sold, never taken public. Every Miele appliance is tested to a 20-year lifespan equivalent (5,000 hours of use simulation). Their dishwashers use AutoDos automatic detergent dispensing and the G7000 at 37 dBA is the quietest consumer dishwasher ever made. Miele machines are built in Germany and command a premium because they genuinely last longer than anything else on the market.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Lifetime buyers who calculate cost-per-year, not sticker price. Design professionals who trust the brand implicitly. Customers tired of replacing appliances every 7 years.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Miele:

• 20-year tested lifespan — Miele tests every product to 10,000 cycles before it ships

• AutoDos dispenses exactly the right amount of detergent automatically for up to 20 loads

• 37 dBA G7000 dishwasher — quieter than a whisper, quietest ever made

• TwinDos washer premixes detergent for better cleaning than manual dosing

• Family-owned since 1899 — no shareholders demanding cost cuts, just engineering excellence
